title: Simple Printing
code:
# Example: Printing primitive data with print

print("Hello, World!")
print("Here are integers:", 10, 99)
print("Here are floats: ", 3.1415, 0.001)
print("Here are strings: ", "IS12", "hello!")

lines.code: # Example: Printing primitive data with print
lines.explanation: This is a comment. A string that starts with a hash symbol will be ignored by the interpreter and could be used for comments. In this case, it explains the nature of the file content
To print a string of symbols, use print function and provide the string delimited by double quotes inside brackets. This line of code prints Hello, World! when interpreted

Print function can have several papameters separated by comas. It prints the values of all its parameters one by one, left to right, separating them by a space. This line will print Here are integers 10 99

This print function has three parameters. First is string "Here are floats", second is a floating point literal 3.1414 and third is another floating point literal 0.001. It prints the values of these three parameters one by one, separating by a blank. The result will be Here are floats:  3.1415 0.001
This print function has three parameters, all are strings. It will print all of them left to right separating by a blank. The result will be Here are strings:  IS12 hello!
